messages:
Mina (Design): quick thread: forms validation in Pools create/edit and bulk-delete. two quick debates: 1) required-field signaling: asterisk vs explicit 'Required' label, 2) inline per-field errors vs top summary for bulk ops. also want to revisit typed-confirm copy for destructive deletes. Carla (PM): for required fields i lean explicit 'Required' for clarity and a11y. asterisks are ambiguous for some users. Ethan (Eng): explicit word is easier for screen readers too. but it adds visual density. Maybe show 'Required' text only on focus/hover or for small screens? Liam (DevEx): focus-based reveal can hide info from keyboard users. prefer visible text but make it visually muted (lower contrast) so its not loud for dense forms. Mina (Design): good point. proposal: visible "Required" microlabel for the first input in a form and a compact asterisk for the rest, with an accessible keyline at top that explains the convention ("* = required"). Thoughts? Carla (PM): that hybrid feels confusing. simpler: always show 'Required' for inputs we care about (name, owner) and use asterisk for optional niceties like description. keep product clarity over density. Ethan (Eng): ok if we do 'Required' for key fields. will need a migration plan for many screens. Mina (Design): noted. second debate: inline errors vs summary for bulk delete. if you delete 10 pools and 3 fail (permissions or locked), do we show inline rows or a single summary panel with anchors? Liam (DevEx): summary+anchors for bulk is my vote. then keyboard users can tab through anchors to failing rows. but also show small inline expand for the first 2 failures so context is visible. Ethan (Eng): implementationally that's easy: return an errors array, build a top summary with links to `#row-{id}` and render collapsed details inline for the first two ids. need to ensure focus after submit goes to the summary. Mina (Design): accessibility: how do we announce number of failures to SR users? a11y-bot: recommendation: move focus to a container with role="status" and aria-live="polite" that contains the summary message. Example: `
3 items failed to delete
`. Summary links should include `aria-controls` pointing to the row detail region. Expanded row details should use `role="region"` and `aria-labelledby`. Carla (PM): typed-confirm for destructive actions: we still debating typed-confirm vs checkbox for pool deletes. Any strong opinions? Ethan (Eng): typed-confirm is safest but introduces friction. suggestion: conditional typed-confirm when pool has org-level ownership or >50 members. otherwise checkbox + stronger CTA copy. if typed-confirm is used: `autocomplete=\"off\"`, `autofocus`, disable confirm until exact match (trimmed). support paste. Liam (DevEx): also add an acceptance test: keyboard-only flow, ensure user can cancel with ESC and focus returns to trigger. visible focus styles on the typed input and `aria-invalid` when mismatch. error text should be concise: 'Names do not match.' Mina (Design): copy tweak: instead of "Type the pool name to confirm", prefer "Enter the pool name to permanently delete this pool." adds severity and specificity. Carla (PM): agree. add a small bullet about reversible actions in the copy only if we offer undo. if we don't, say permanent. Mina (Design): decisions summary? Ethan (Eng): summary: 1) Required label: use explicit 'Required' for primary fields, asterisk for less critical fields; make microcopy consistent. 2) Bulk errors: top summary with aria-live + anchors, inline expanded details for first 2 failures. Move focus to summary after submit. 3) Typed-confirm: conditional by pool sensitivity; if enabled, autofocus, disable CTA until exact match, allow paste, set `autocomplete=off`. 4) Copy: use 'Enter the pool name to permanently delete this pool.' Liam (DevEx): i'll add keyboard/a11y acceptance criteria to PR template and include a small test plan. Mina (Design): I'll update mocks and the component spec and post a follow-up. tagging @Ethan @Liam @Carla for review. Carla (PM): thanks all, updating the spec now. Ethan (Eng): will review mocks when uploaded.
